title: Mother and Son on Couch, 1954 US B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A family moment captured on September 26, 1954, during Ma's Anniversary. A young man sits affectionately next to his mother on an upholstered, floral-patterned sofa in a cozy living room setting. A small child is curled up asleep on the couch cushion next to them. The background features decorative scenic wallpaper and a tall vintage floor lamp.
